seoTitle: Canonical Conflict Checker: canonical, og:url, hreflang
metaDescription: Compare canonical, og:url, twitter:url and hreflang self-reference in pasted HTML and see where they disagree. Free.
intro: Lists the URL signals in a page and highlights mismatches.
why:
Conflicting signals confuse crawlers. A canonical with http, an og:url with a trailing slash and an hreflang self-reference with another form are common.

The tool parses each URL and tells you the part that differs (scheme, www, path, trailing slash, query). It words findings as things to review. Add the page URL to resolve relative links.

faq.a: Not always: duplicates should point elsewhere.
Each page should list itself, and the self URL should match the canonical.
It compares URLs as parsed. A crawl shows what engines choose.
